Who’s Milo??

He may be small, but he has a very big heart. Sweet, brave, and always curious, Milo loves exploring, playing, and spending time with his best friend, Fiadh.

Whether they’re off on a little adventure or curled up for a cozy nap, Milo is happiest when they’re together.

What about
Fiadh?

Meet Fiadh (pronounced fee-ah)! A curious little girl with a big personality and a love for discovering new things. She’s playful, kind, and always ready for a little adventure.

With her best friend Milo by her side, even the simplest moments become something special!
